name: scratch-helper-by-creaticode
description: Learn Scratch, build games and animations, and fix scripts with real block pictures, public-project explanations and small playable demos.

interface.longDescription:
Learn Scratch, build games and animations, and fix coding problems with real block pictures and runnable CreatiCode projects. Ask for help with movement, jumping, scoring, loops, variables, clones, 3D, AI, physics, and debugging. Share a public Scratch or CreatiCode project link for an explanation or a modified CreatiCode copy.

Supports MIT Scratch and CreatiCode. Say "MIT Scratch" for standard Scratch blocks. CreatiCode projects can also use 3D, AI and physics blocks. Follow-up changes can update the same generated project.

For learners aged 13+, teachers and parents. Only public source projects can be read. Generated projects use simple pictures and are unlisted on CreatiCode; optional MIT Scratch demos are public. Some blocks or project changes may not be supported; the app will report an error if it cannot create a project. Download links expire after one hour. AI answers can contain mistakes, so check the scripts.

CreatiCode and Scratch Helper by CreatiCode are owned and operated by Uplifting Technology Inc.
